instagram.caption:
ChatGPT just opened business listings. Read the small print before you claim yours.
OpenAI calls it Business Hub. It's in beta, and it's where you claim your business in ChatGPT. OpenAI says 1.2 billion people use ChatGPT every week.
1. Open Business Hub. OpenAI says it's in your ChatGPT sidebar, or go to chatgpt.com/business-hub
2. Search your business name. The line under the search box says: "By continuing, you accept OpenAI's Businesses in ChatGPT Terms." Those terms say OpenAI's AI assistant may call your business for its users (you can opt out), and you agree not to bring certain claims against OpenAI. Read them first.
3. Prove it's yours with a method OpenAI offers you, such as your business phone, a business email or your website domain.
4. Pass an identity check before any change goes live.
The catch: OpenAI's help page says local stores and restaurants can only claim a listing that already exists, U.S. only for now. A plumber or a roofer? Search and see.
OpenAI says claiming it doesn't guarantee ChatGPT recommends you more.
Is your business in there yet?
Save this, and send it to whoever runs your Google listing.
Source: OpenAI, "Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT" (Nov 10, 2026); OpenAI Help Center, "Setting up your business on ChatGPT"; OpenAI, "Businesses in ChatGPT Terms". All read Nov 12, 2026. The Business Hub screens are from our own account.

#chatgpt #smallbusiness #contractor #localbusiness
